name: io.github.Wh-bi/wanhe-compliance
title: Wanhe Compliance — Chinese Content Compliance Checker
description: Chinese content compliance checking for AI agents. Detects advertising-law prohibited terms (China Advertising Law Art. 9 superlatives, Art. 17-18 disease-treatment and health-food claims, Art. 28 false advertising) and flags AI-generated content labeling requirements (Measures for Labeling AI-Generated Synthetic Content Art. 4-5 + mandatory national standard GB 45438-2025). Returns per-issue findings with the exact legal provision and a suggested fix. Free tier: 2000 chars/request, 30 requests/hour per IP. Rule engine (reproducible), not model inference.
